qualification_currentness.reason: Current head contains later source/test/experiment work. Historical exact-head test evidence does not transfer automatically.

rules: Benchmark records are append-only experiment subjects; a summary pointer does not rewrite an older run.
Different workload shapes are not compared as if they were one repeated experiment.
Changing current_reference_experiment does not transfer verification or qualification.
Contradictory or repeated runs remain side-by-side evidence until explicitly reconciled.
Training or hosted-compute authorization is not granted by this registry.
